findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_domain, request_merchant_check, request_insolvency_check, request_sanctions_screening, request_trademark_check, request_phone_check, request_human_review, request_perception_check · Private data: check_email_domain, request_phone_check, request_usability_test, request_fax · Public sink: submit_request, respond_to_request, check_email_domain, request_postal_letter, request_fax · Destructive: check_phone_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_domain, request_merchant_check, request_insolvency_check, request_sanctions_screening, request_trademark_check, request_phone_check, request_human_review, request_perception_check · Private data: check_email_domain, request_phone_check, request_usability_test, request_fax · Public sink: submit_request, respond_to_request, check_email_domain, request_postal_letter, request_fax · Destructive: check_phone_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
